quick_skim.title: Reification as a Transferable Vocabulary: Zero-Shot Link Prediction with Vanilla GNNs
quick_skim.abstract: Knowledge graph foundation models such as ULTRA achieve zero-shot link prediction on unseen graphs through dedicated architectures that hard-code a transfer mechanism. In this work we move that mechanism out of the architecture and into the representation, by \emph{reifying} the input graph: every fact becomes a node, connected to its subject, object, and relation type through a fixed vocabulary of six meta-relations, with relation types as anonymous shared nodes rather than model parameters. On this representation, five textbook GNNs (GAT, GINE with sum and with mean+max aggregation, GraphSAGE, R-GCN), each trained on a single knowledge graph of 4,245 triples for 30 minutes on one NVIDIA A100, transfer zero-shot to 40 inductive link-prediction benchmarks. The best of them, an off-the-shelf GAT, matches ULTRA, a dedicated foundation model pretrained on three graphs, across ULTRA's own evaluation suite. The same fixed vocabulary extends to relational databases, a row becoming an entity and a foreign-key column a relation type; a preliminary probe on two unseen databases, with no cell values, schema text or in-context labels, shows a model of this family pretrained on three knowledge graphs ranking foreign-key targets far above random-initialization and degree controls. We release the code, the checkpoints, and the evaluation pipeline for all 40 benchmarks.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: By reifying knowledge graphs into a fixed six-meta-relation vocabulary, textbook GNNs trained on a single small graph transfer zero-shot to 40 inductive link-prediction datasets without specialized architectures.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 知识图谱基础模型依赖专门架构硬编码迁移机制，才能在未见图上实现零样本链接预测。本文把迁移机制从架构移入表示，通过具体化将每条事实变为节点，以六种元关系与匿名关系类型节点构成固定词汇表，再训练经典GNN。实验表明五种教科书GNN在单个小规模知识图谱上训练后，可零样本迁移到40个归纳链接预测数据集，对未见药物节点预测有借鉴意义。
